Verified against a published number -- Qi et al. report Cronbach's alpha for THIS sample as .91 (PA) and .88 (NA), and the shipped block assignment gives .906 and .876, within .005 of both. The strongest available route is a semantic-facet prediction inside the NA block -- fear {害怕, 紧张, 惊恐, 战战兢兢}, self-conscious {内疚, 羞愧}, anger {恼怒, 易怒}, sadness {难过} should show higher within-facet than between-facet correlations -- scored as mean(within r) - mean(between r) over all 9! = 362,880 relabellings. The shipped order scores -0.0012 and ranks 175,681st of 362,880 (top 48.4%), i.e. exactly chance. Two other routes were tried and also failed to discriminate: per-item correlations with a correctly keyed Rosenberg total (Esteem items 3,5,8,9,10 reversed; alpha .885 against the paper's published .89) run 0.21-0.57 across the PA items and -0.24 to -0.53 across NA with no pattern matching the predicted content (羞愧的/ashamed, predicted to be the most esteem-negative NA item, is the LEAST at -0.24), and the same for a SWLS total. The 18 adjectives are same-range, same-polarity single words within each block, so there is nothing for a statistic to grip -- this is the trap the instrument_rights_register already records for the Temporal Focus Scale.
